input_sources: data/extracted/*/*_FLUXMET_YY_*.csv (read from scratch, no repo helpers) vs. data/duckdb/fluxnet.duckdb annual_converted table (dataset='FLUXMET')
notes: Independent re-derivation of mean annual P_ERA/P_F/NEE_VUT_REF for 5 metadata-unchanged sites, using a from-scratch base-R CSV reader with no pipeline helper functions. Exact agreement (diffs ~1e-12) once compared against the correct dataset='FLUXMET' subset of annual_converted -- documents a real dataset-column filtering pitfall in that table, found independently of era5_precip_units_v2's prior documentation of the same issue.
